definitions.explanation: The ability to perceive through physical contact, including pressure, texture, and temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じて→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧{触覚|しょっかく}⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧。
examples.english: Guess objects using only your sense of touch with your eyes closed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{触覚|しょっかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧だ。
examples.english: Babies have a sensitive sense of touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指先|ゆびさき}→指先：12727_yubisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{触覚|しょっかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スイッチ→スイッチ：03848_suicchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: Relying on the sense of touch in my fingertips, I felt for the light switch in the dark room.

notes:
The five senses (⟦{五感|ごかん}→五感：05698_gokan⟧):
- ⟦{視覚|しかく}→視覚：02837_shikaku⟧ (sight)
- ⟦{聴覚|ちょうかく}→聴覚：13911_choukaku⟧ (hearing)
- ⟦{嗅覚|きゅうかく}→嗅覚：04422_kyuukaku⟧ (smell)
- ⟦{味覚|みかく}→味覚：04424_mikaku⟧ (taste)
- {触覚|しょっかく} (touch)

Common expressions:
- {触覚|しょっかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ (to have a keen sense of touch)

WATCH OUT:
An insect's antennae are ⟦{触角|しょっかく}→触角：31305_shokkaku⟧, a different word with the same reading (casually also ⟦アンテナ→アンテナ：19552_antena⟧); ⟦{触角|しょっかく}→触角：31305_shokkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ (to put out feelers) uses it too. Writing {触覚|しょっかく} for antennae is a common slip.
